title: Pi agent permissions
description: Permission rules enforced by the permissions.ts extension. Each section maps a glob pattern to an action. "*" is the fallback default within a section; the most specific (longest literal) matching pattern wins.

$schema.description: Points to this schema file for editor validation.

bash.description: Glob patterns matched against the full bash command line.

read.description: Glob patterns matched against the path argument of the read tool.

write.description: Glob patterns matched against the path argument of the write tool.

edit.description: Glob patterns matched against the path argument of the edit tool.

external_directory.description: Applied in addition to the section rules when the path resolves outside the current working directory.

tools.description: Glob patterns matched against tool names (e.g. MCP tools). Not needed for bash/read/write/edit, which have their own sections.

additionalProperties.description: allow: run without prompting. ask: prompt the user first (blocked in non-interactive mode). deny: always block.

rules.description: Glob pattern -> action. In path sections (read/write/edit/external_directory), a lone '*' matches any path, '*' matches within one path segment, '**' crosses segments, and '~' / '$HOME' are expanded.
